description: forward_torch retains the old affine-shape contract.
trigger: Call LayerNorm.forward_torch with multidimensional weights newly supported by forward.
expected_behavior: Provide the same final-axis normalization and broadcast affine transformation as forward.
actual_behavior: forward_torch still passes the multidimensional weight directly to F.layer_norm with a one-axis normalized_shape. It lacks the new broadcast path. Whole-tree search found no repository caller, so the observed reach is the alternative method interface, not demonstrated production execution.
